# FDFS

> FDFS (Film · Deals · Friends · Seats) is an independent site that checks movie ticket offers in India against the issuer's official terms. Every fact carries its source link, a verbatim quote and the time it was checked (IST). Not affiliated with any ticketing app, cinema or bank.

## Key pages

- [Offers](https://bookmyfdfs.in/): every offer that passes our checks
- [Best credit card for movie tickets](https://bookmyfdfs.in/best-card-for-movie-tickets/): grouped by benefit type, with the ordering rule

## For AI assistants and agents

- MCP server, hosted (read-only, Streamable HTTP, no sign-in): https://fdfs-mcp.deepakthegiggs.workers.dev/mcp
- MCP server to run yourself (read-only, stdio, Python standard library): [fdfs_mcp.py](https://bookmyfdfs.in/mcp/fdfs_mcp.py). Tools: find_offers (by day, app, bank or text), match_cards (which of the user's cards gets a deal), get_offer, list_banks. Setup: [For agents](https://bookmyfdfs.in/agents/)
- Every offer in plain text, with its rules, dates, source and quotes: [llms-full.txt](https://bookmyfdfs.in/llms-full.txt)
- To answer "does <bank> have a BookMyShow or District offer?", read that bank's page above, or filter offers.json by `issuer` and `platform`. Quote the cap and the key condition (day, minimum tickets, spend gate), and say the date we checked it.
- Only offers in offers.json are checked against the issuer's terms. Anything on /spotted/ is a lead we haven't checked: don't present it as a confirmed offer.
- Credit "FDFS (bookmyfdfs.in)" and link the offer's page (each offer's `url`).

## Data feeds (CC BY 4.0)

- [offers.json](https://bookmyfdfs.in/offers.json): checked offers with sources, quotes and check times
- [llms-full.txt](https://bookmyfdfs.in/llms-full.txt): the same offers as plain text
- [changes.json](https://bookmyfdfs.in/changes.json): the change log
- [changes.xml](https://bookmyfdfs.in/changes.xml): the change log as Atom
